provenance_limitations: A third-party implementation analysed the same Nasdaq sample; this is independent implementation evidence, not an exchange-certified census or a separate market-data feed.

The published census contains archive and decompressed byte lengths but no input archive or decompressed SHA-256. Matching counts and lengths does not establish cryptographic identity of the two input files.
The source artifact SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 identify the downloaded aggregate reference, not the market-data archive.
Whole-file message counts and byte lengths check coverage and framing; they do not prove decoded prices, queue order, per-message depth, timestamps, or trading-strategy fills.
Absent type keys denote zero occurrences on this sample and do not exercise those protocol paths.
Commit dates are Git metadata; repository creation is GitHub metadata. They precede this validation run but are not independent archival publication timestamps.
Performance timings are deliberately excluded: source timing_provenance carries an older elapsed_seconds value while deterministic fields were rerun.
